name: teleport-card-transfer
intent: Card compresses at source aperture, holds empty mid-transfer 120ms, then reconstructs at destination aperture.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Card appears already reconstructed at destination

acceptance: Compress at source apertureFromPx 8 → apertureToPx 72 over compressMs 200
Mid empty hold midHoldMs 120 with card opacity 0 / neither slot occupied
Reconstruct at destination over reconstructMs 220 then status ARRIVED
Replay returns card to source before rerunning
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows ARRIVED immediately
